news.title: Robinhood Launches Crypto Trading in UK, Integrates With Bitstamp
news.body: Robinhood has launched crypto trading in the UK by integrating with Bitstamp, allowing users to buy and sell digital assets alongside stocks, ISAs, options, and futures. This makes Robinhood one of the few UK platforms to offer both traditional and crypto assets in a single app, directly challenging local brokers and crypto exchanges. UK retail investors can now manage a wider range of assets through Robinhood, prompting competitors to accelerate their own product offerings to keep pace.

news.title: Visa and Mastercard Join Circle to Pilot Stablecoin Payments
news.body: Visa and Mastercard have joined a new stablecoin working group with Circle, focusing on testing stablecoin settlement for card payments. This collaboration could enable faster, lower-cost merchant settlements and give card networks early experience with programmable money. While stablecoins have often been discussed as a threat to card rails, this move positions Visa and Mastercard to shape how tokenized payments are integrated into mainstream commerce.

news.title: OCC Denies Bunq’s US Banking License, Delaying Fintech’s Expansion
news.body: The OCC has rejected Dutch fintech Bunq’s application for a US banking license, citing insufficient detail on its American expansion plans. Bunq cannot offer full-service banking in the US for now, forcing it to reconsider its entry strategy or seek partnerships. This decision delays Bunq’s growth in the US and signals that regulators remain cautious about granting charters to foreign fintechs, potentially slowing similar expansion efforts by other European challengers.

news.title: Chime CFO Steps Down After Revenue Surge, President Takes Interim Role
news.body: Chime’s CFO has resigned following a 27% jump in Q2 revenue, with the company’s president assuming interim finance leadership. Chime’s executive team is actively steering the company through a period of rapid growth, but the leadership transition introduces questions about future financial strategy and fundraising. Investors and competitors will monitor how Chime manages this change as it continues to expand its US neobank presence.

news.title: Brazil Imposes 24-Hour Delay on Crypto Transfers to Counter Social Engineering Scams
news.body: Brazil’s central bank now requires crypto exchanges to delay overseas transfers by 24 hours, specifically targeting social engineering scams and unauthorized account takeovers that have surged in recent months. The rule slows cross-border crypto transactions for Brazilian users and compels exchanges to enhance fraud detection and customer verification processes. This urgent measure reflects growing regulatory concern over consumer protection in the rapidly expanding Brazilian crypto market.

perspective: Robinhood’s UK crypto launch and the Visa-Mastercard stablecoin pilot highlight how traditional and fintech players are reshaping digital asset payments.
